entities.name: Five Trees
entities.description: Five spiritually significant trees in the Jukai forest on Kamigawa, each with its kodama.

entities.name: Tree of All Seasons
entities.description: Tallest of the Five Trees, in the center.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War in which the kodamas joined the kami against the mortal world.

entities.name: Kodama
entities.description: Spirits guarding each of the Five Trees.

entities.name: Neon Dynasty
entities.description: Era about 1200 years after the Kami War.

events.summary: The kodamas of the Five Trees join the side of the kami against the mortal world in the Kami War.
events.quote: their kodamas all joined the side of the kami against the mortal world

relations.quote: located in the Jukai forest in Kamigawa
